events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Festival took place in 1969, featuring legendary performances from Jimi Hendrix and The Who.

angles.name: Woodstock Legacy
angles.copy: It's been 57 years since the iconic Woodstock Festival, we're looking back at the performances that defined a generation.

events.title: Elvis Presley Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Elvis Presley passed away on this day in 1977, leaving behind a legacy as the King of Rock and Roll.

angles.name: Remembering Elvis
angles.copy: Today we remember the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away 49 years ago.

events.title: Tupac Shakur Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Tupac Shakur was shot dead in Las Vegas on this day in 1996, his music and legacy continue to inspire and influence new generations.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: 30 years on from his tragic death, we're celebrating the life and music of Tupac Shakur.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970, leaving behind a legacy as one of the greatest guitarists of all time.

angles.name: Remembering Jimi
angles.copy: Today we remember the legendary Jimi Hendrix, who passed away 56 years ago.

events.title: The Beatles Release Abbey Road
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album Abbey Road on this day in 1969, featuring classic tracks like Come Together and Here Comes the Sun.

angles.name: Abbey Road Turns 57
angles.copy: One of the most iconic albums in history, Abbey Road, was released 57 years ago today.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' lead singer Chrissie Hynde turns 75 today, with a career spanning over four decades.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde at 75
angles.copy: The iconic voice of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 55
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher turns 55 today, with a career spanning over three decades.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher at 55
angles.copy: The iconic voice of Oasis, Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 55th birthday today.

events.title: John Lennon Releases Imagine
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic album Imagine on this day in 1971, featuring the classic title track.

angles.name: Imagine Turns 55
angles.copy: John Lennon's iconic album Imagine was released 55 years ago today, featuring some of his most enduring songs.

events.title: Apple Releases the First iPod
events.blurb: Apple released the first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionizing the way we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Turns 25
angles.copy: The first iPod was released 25 years ago today, changing the music industry forever.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today is James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic spy created by Ian Fleming.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day, and we're celebrating the world's most iconic spy.

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon would have been 86 today, with a legacy as one of the most influential musicians of all time.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Today we remember John Lennon, who would have been 86 years old, and celebrate his enduring legacy.

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: Comedy legend John Cleese turns 87 today, with a career spanning over five decades.

angles.name: John Cleese at 87
angles.copy: The legendary John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today, and we're looking back at his incredible career.

events.title: The Beatles Release the White Album
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic self-titled album, commonly known as the White Album, on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Turns 58
angles.copy: The Beatles' groundbreaking White Album was released 58 years ago today, featuring some of their most innovative and influential work.

events.title: Freddie Mercury Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury passed away on this day in 1991, leaving behind a legacy as one of the greatest rock frontmen of all time.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Today we remember the incredible Freddie Mercury, who passed away 35 years ago.
